articles.mainIdea: PARAMOUNT APPOINTS DENNIS K. CINELLI AS CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER AND ADDS ANDREW CAMPION TO ITS BOARD OF DIRECTORS
articles.summary: PR Newswire: PARAMOUNT APPOINTS DENNIS K. CINELLI AS CHIEF FINANCIAL OFFICER AND ADDS ANDREW CAMPION TO ITS BOARD OF DIRECTORS. Paramount, a Skydance Corporation (Nasdaq: PSKY) today announced that Dennis K. Cinelli will join the company's executive leadership team as Chief Financial Officer, effective January 15, 2026, and as such has resigned his Board of Directors seat.
